system.description:
The vampire can momentarily see through the eyes of every animal roaming the night within her range, gaining a general sense of an area or specific details as needed, including impressions of upcoming events like storms or disasters.

System: The player makes a Perception + Animal Ken Test. Each success can be spent on range or on detail, and the player divides successes between the two as desired: one success gives a general impression of everything within earshot; two extend range to about a mile with blurry details; three reach a couple of miles with clear details; four reach fifty miles while also picking up faint sound; five reach a hundred miles with clear sight and sound. The vampire cannot perceive anything Obfuscated or otherwise hidden through this power. Gangrel often use this power while interred in the earth.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book One: Animals
